units.source_text: 岛村觉得这次回去，暂时是不可能再到这个温泉浴场来了。

en.t: Shimamura felt that once he went back this time, he would probably not be able to come to this hot spring resort again for a while.

units.source_text: 雪季将至，他靠近火盆，听见了客栈主人特地拿出来的京都出产的古老铁壶发出了柔和的水沸声。

en.t: With the snow season drawing near, he leaned close to the brazier and heard the soft sound of water boiling in an old iron kettle from Kyoto that the innkeeper had specially brought out.

units.source_text: 铁壶上面精巧地镶嵌着银丝花鸟。

en.t: The iron kettle was delicately inlaid with silver-thread flowers and birds.

units.source_text: 水沸声有二重音，听起来一近一远。

en.t: The boiling water made a double sound, one seeming near and the other far away.

units.source_text: 而比远处水沸声稍远些的地方，仿佛不断响起微弱的小铃声。

en.t: And from a place a little farther off than the distant sound of the boiling water, a faint little bell seemed to keep ringing.

units.source_text: 岛村把耳朵贴近铁壶，听了听那铃声。

en.t: Shimamura put his ear close to the iron kettle and listened to that bell-like sound.

units.source_text: 驹子在铃声不断的远处，踏着同铃声相似的细碎的脚步走了过来。

en.t: From the distance where the ringing went on, Komako came walking toward him with quick, tiny steps like the sound of the bell.

units.source_text: 她那双小脚赫然映入岛村的眼帘。

en.t: Her small feet suddenly came into Shimamura's view.

units.source_text: 岛村吃了一惊，不禁暗自想道：已经到该离开这里的时候了。

en.t: Shimamura was startled and could not help thinking to himself that the time had already come to leave this place.
